In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with a deep sense of devotion and commitment to one's faith, inspired by the life of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his wife Hajar, who is also known as Amina bint Abidah in Islamic sources. The name Abida can be seen as a reminder of the importance of devotion, commitment, and faithfulness in Islamic practice.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Abida embodies the core Islamic principle of Tawheed, or the belief in the Oneness of Allah. Abida signifies the individual's absolute dedication and submission to Allah. This spiritual significance goes deeper than just the literal meaning of the name; it represents a person's inner spirit and commitment to their faith in action. The name Abida serves as a reminder that all of our actions, thoughts, and intentions should be centered around Allah, and that our ultimate goal in life is to worship and serve Him.
